findings.message: The mobile branch accepts optional c/m-prefixed extensions through CODE_FILE, but the installed mobile Jest testMatch only collects js/jsx/ts/tsx names. A hermetic actual Jest --listTests run selects control.test.ts and __tests__/control.check.ts but excludes invisible.test.mjs, __tests__/hidden.check.mjs and invisible.test.mts; this submitted guard classifies all three excluded files as collected and reports no unreachable tests. This preserves a false-success path under the task's actual-runner contract and inflates the collected count. Keep broad candidate scanning but match mobile collection to the existing Jest rules, then add an actual collection-only Jest regression with these negative and legitimate positive controls; do not change runner configs or dependencies. Reproduction and non-execution marker evidence are in reviews/T231-871e0857-baseb6add75f.jest-repro.{mjs,json}.
